symptomShortText: Customer incoming inspection rejected 150 anodized frames due to surface pitting and color mottling

defect.defectText: Pitting corrosion and dark discoloration on anodized aluminum bezel

causesIshikawa.description: EMP-2281, Shift A - anodizing line operator followed racking spacing and current ramp procedure
EQ-ANOD01-003 rectifier voltage and temperature bath chilling operated within standard envelope
DOC-4401 Rev E - black dye immersion time 8 min and nickel acetate sealing 20 min compliant
Extruded aluminium 6063-T6 alloy certificate compliant, iron and copper content within limits
Eddy-current thickness gauge GA-0610 calibrated on ISO reference foils

Deionized (DI) post-anodize rinse water tank conductivity climbed to 34.5 uS/cm (limit 5.0 uS/cm) due to exhausted mixed-bed ion exchange resin, leaving chloride residue that pitted the unsealed oxide pores

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did the customer reject the anodized bezel frames?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Micro-pitting and white bloom spotting appeared under cosmetic inspection lighting

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did micro-pitting develop on the anodized oxide layer?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Chloride ions trapped inside unsealed anodic pores initiated localized galvanic micro-corrosion during hot sealing

fiveWhyChain.question: Why were chloride ions present in the sealing bath rinse? (root cause)
fiveWhyChain.answer: The DI water purification resin bed reached exhaustion over the weekend and the inline conductivity sensor alarm was muted
fiveWhyChain.evidenceCitation: DI water plant maintenance log and conductivity alarm historian

actions.actionText: Quarantine 150 frames at customer dock and sort 320 finished frames in central stock
Dump and recharge DI rinse tank 3; replace exhausted mixed-bed ion exchange resin cylinders
Hardwire conductivity sensor high-limit alarm (>5.0 uS/cm) to line conveyor PLC to halt hoist transfer automatically

fmeaLink.description: Pitting corrosion in anodic oxide coating due to contaminated DI rinse water

lessonsLearned.whatWorked: SEM/EDX micro-analysis pinpointed chloride contamination within 4 hours
lessonsLearned.whatDidnt: Alarm acknowledge button allowed line operators to continue running with contaminated water

isIsNot.isWhereWhenItHappens: Bezel Frame BF-10 processed through WC-ANOD-01 rinse tank 3 on 2026-08-08 morning run
isIsNot.isNotWhereWhenItDoesnt: Frames processed after resin tank replacement on 2026-08-09 reading 1.8 uS/cm
isIsNot.notes: Pitting failure directly tracked rinse tank conductivity spike above 30 uS/cm
